what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1489 refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in Germany, 0.1% of all refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Uganda hosts the most refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, followed by Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in periods from 1996 to 2025, with M23 among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at its highest figure, 7370 refugees.
It has fallen since then; the main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005 and 2007 to 2012.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
